reviews.title: The worst betting site I’ve ever used
reviews.text:
I deposited money into my account after signing up, but the verification process has now taken more than two weeks. They have repeatedly asked me to upload the same documents again without providing any clear explanation as to why.

Every time, I have to contact customer service myself to ask for an update. The response is always the same robotic message: they have received an overwhelming number of requests, will review my case as soon as possible, and will contact me by email.

However, after waiting and waiting, there are basically no updates unless I contact their customer service again myself.

The worst part is that they have effectively held my money for more than two weeks without giving me any clear reason, while also not allowing me to withdraw or refund the money back to my bank account.

reviews.title: Cash out Errors
reviews.text: I had a bet on with a stake of £25 for a return of £325. The bet was very close to coming in with 20 mins in the game to go. For the whole game there was an issue with the cash out due to an “error”. The bet ended up losing, but I got no option for a cash out for any of the remaining time in the game. Anyway paddy power excuse was that the provider of the game coverage that they’re partnered with don’t hold up their end of the agreement, therefore the coverage broke down during the game and paddy power couldn’t keep tabs on any live updates. Basically I got shafted because paddy power and whoever streams the game for them messed up. For anyone thinking about using paddy power, don’t. The app is a nuisance to work and even when you figure it out they screw you over in a bet due to “technical difficulties”. You’re far better off using an app like Bet365.

reviews.title: Confusing settlement and unhelpful support.
reviews.text:
Really disappointed with this experience.

I placed a bet on an NCAA basketball game for total points. The market didn’t say “including overtime” anywhere on the bet slip or in the bet builder. Paddy Power often labels markets clearly as “normal time” or “incl. overtime”, so when there’s no wording at all, it’s genuinely confusing as a customer.

The game went to overtime and the bet was settled including OT. When I contacted support, I was repeatedly pointed back to generic rules rather than anyone acknowledging how unclear the market looked at the time I placed the bet.

I wasn’t trying to bend the rules — I was just asking for some understanding or goodwill given the confusion. Instead, I was basically told to check the rules every time, even when market details aren’t shown.

Left feeling let down and like common-sense customer care just wasn’t there. Not the experience I expected.
